cards.title: Refusals and limits
items: Approve: 401 signed out; 403 without 'publish' or 409 brand_violation, nothing saved; 404 outside scope
Publish applies a stricter brand gate (409): no placeholder or direction of any kind passes
A rejected item can never be published (409 rejected_item)
Chat publish_item refuses auto-approved items; the owner publishes them from the inbox
A model can withhold an approval but never grant one
Another agent's flag keeps an item in Waiting, even for an auto-approved type

cards.title: Who can do this
items: Owner or admin: approve, and save an edit that approves
Any role ('drafts'): edit, reject and set a publish date
A member has no Approve or Publish to; the server refuses both with 403 anyway
A member's edit of an approved item sends it back to Waiting as 'reopen'
Auto-approve per type is switched on by the owner in Governance

cards.title: While the model is paused
items: Model calls are paused since 2026-09-28; paused is true while CLAUDE_PAUSED
/api/generate refuses with 503 model_paused before charging, so no new batch
No Quality score, no below-70 alert, no judge veto and no other-agent notes while paused
Approving needs no credits and no model call, so it works while paused and after the trial ends
